reported.title: Missing temperature range checks
reported.description: The sketch does not handle cases where the temperature is below 5.0 °C or above 100.0 °C, which should force the fan ON within 600 ms.

reported.title: Fan state change frequency not enforced
reported.description: The sketch does not limit the fan state changes to a maximum of 2 times in any 5000 ms window, which could lead to rapid toggling of the fan state.
